intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Build one independently randomized, complex photorealistic test concept for a later image render, using the attached portrait only for facial and general appearance continuity while reserving wardrobe specifics for the post-core test.

Create a vertical photorealistic full-body editorial photograph inside a restored art-deco ferry terminal just after a hard rain. One unmistakably adult woman, carrying only facial and general appearance continuity from the supplied portrait—long dark softly waved hair, warm brown eyes, and a calm composed presence—stands beneath an illuminated brass departure clock. She is caught mid-handoff, extending a rain-speckled, wax-sealed archival parcel low and outward toward a dispatch clerk's gloved hand entering from a side parcel window; the exchange remains clearly visible without crossing her body. A delayed-ferry notice, wet terrazzo reflections, geometric glass, and an opened manifest on a narrow brass shelf make the moment feel urgent yet plausible. Frame her head to toe, upright and large in the vertical frame, with natural anatomy and grounded feet. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Keep the parcel and architecture spatially separated from those outfit regions.

obligation.composition_instruction: Preserve the requested adult fictional identity, role, wardrobe, and visual style. In one still, keep a calm low-expression baseline visibly stable while one concrete, quiet practical action helps one identifiable trusted adult counterpart and leaves an already-visible helpful consequence for that same counterpart. Add only one localized warmth leak, such as slight lower-lid easing, a restrained brow release, a fractional mouth-corner softening, or reduced tension in the hand or shoulder nearest the target. Optional outward support may use economical gesture, stable upright posture, a neat simple silhouette, restrained grooming, or a muted/cool-neutral palette, but these are conventions rather than requirements. Do not assign fixed hair color, eye color, hairstyle, costume, gender, occupation, gaze direction, camera angle, or prop, and do not let expressionlessness, competence, beauty, a cool palette, or a caring object substitute for the same-target action and consequence. Preserve the counterpart's autonomy; avoid hostile denial, shy withdrawal, possessive control, broad open affection, or an abrupt personality switch.
